1117-2866-6518-8346.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

7-4399-4518-8319.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
7-4399-4518-8319.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Hamza.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Greenhouse Propagator trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greenhouse Propagator trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
7-4399-4518-8319.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

628-728-7865.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dream Seizer.
When Dream Seizer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dream Seizer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

874-2866-3899-4986.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-2866-3899-4986.description:
Cast Delif's Cone by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

3259-4885-7659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4885-7659.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-3356-5003-7649.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Thorin, adding {C}{C}.
When Thorin dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Thorin from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Thorin enters, it triggers, attaching Nim Deathmantle to Polyraptor, and then having it deal damage to itself.
Polyraptor triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

4276-5088-5147-7443-7537.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
4276-5088-5147-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
4276-5088-5147-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Turnabout with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Turnabout from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Turnabout.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 18.

2577-5670-7399.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-7399.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1806-2060-2511-3129-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Primal Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

When Spiteful Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.
2034-2116-6972.notes: When Spiteful Squad dies with a +1/+1 counter on it, that counter can be placed onto another creature. If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, it will be removed, allowing it to be returned via persist.

1417-3967-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
1417-3967-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Bridge from Below and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2558-6705-6737-6797.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Frog creature token due to Quina.
When the Frog enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Frog.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2457-6753-7297.description:

Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Zhur-Taa Druid.
Repeat.

3750-4659-6892.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more opponents.
3750-4659-6892.notablePrerequisites: You control two or more creatures that cannot be blocked and killed by two opponents.
3750-4659-6892.description:
Declare at least two creatures as attackers, ensuring to attack at least two opponents.
At the end of your combat phase, Rose's first ability triggers, creating a Junk token for each opponent that was attacked.
Move to your postcombat phase, and activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Junks, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Rose's second ability triggers twice, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

392-3532-4928-5078.description:

Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi and Forgotten Ancient trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Forgotten Ancient trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Priest of Urabrask.
The Soltari Guerrillas ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1887-7009-7068.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Vorinclex.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

338-3490-4050-5870.description:
Gain life.

Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.

Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.

Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

314-4624.description:
Cast Revenge by paying {4}{W}{B}, doubling your life total and causing an opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
Vito triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

1069-1753-5285-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
1069-1753-5285-5499.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.

1637-4377-4423-4426.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1637-4377-4423-4426.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and two other Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and returning Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Play any Island except Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Aesi triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play any Island except Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Aesi triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Aesi trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Aesi trigger, causing you to draw Walk the Aeons from the top of your library.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

1061-2823.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, The Temporal Anchor's first ability triggers, causing you to scry 2, ensuring to put at least one card on the bottom of your library.
The Temporal Anchor's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Temporal Anchor trigger from step 2, causing you to exile Timestream Navigator from the bottom of your library.
Cast Timestream Navigator from exile by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Staff of Compleation's first ability by tapping it and paying 1 life, destroying Nefarious Lich.
When Nefarious Lich leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing its controller to lose the game.

1558-2557-3775.notablePrerequisites:
You have the initiative.
You have completed a dungeon.
1558-2557-3775.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Safana triggers, creating six Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasure tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

251-1494-4013.notablePrerequisites: Denry Klin has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
251-1494-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Sage of Hours.
Sage of Hours enters the battlefield, triggering Denry Klin, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

791-2290-3129.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
791-2290-3129.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spike Feeder.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

1479-3678-3861.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3678-3861.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Emeria, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
